question_en:
The community hospital plans to use the "Universal Symbols for Healthcare" published by SEGD in 2024 for small corridor signs. The full scope includes all symbols in the official single-page main symbol area; the alternative MRI, PET, CT, and CAT Imaging symbols listed separately at the bottom of the page are excluded. Please answer:

After examining these symbols one by one, which images contain at least two separately distinguishable human figures, where each figure has its own head and torso or body? Please provide a complete table of "Symbol Code—Name—Judgment". Which symbols should be included in the "Multi-Figure Composition Re-test", and how many are there in total?

Reclining figures and figures within pictures (picture-in-picture) count; isolated heads, hands, or organs, equipment images, and the teddy bear in the Pediatrics symbol do not count as figures.

The answer must include a complete itemized table of "Symbol Code—Name—Judgment", followed by a Q&A section listing the symbols requiring re-testing and their total count.

# Detailed Simulated Retrieval Trajectory · 1-2-D03

## Step 01 · parse_task / Define set, image units, and delivery fields

Action: Read the prompt, separate "full scope," "visual conditions," "itemized table," and "summary"; first establish the complete member list, then perform filtering.

Evidence observation (archived evidence summary): SEGD 2024 official single-page PDF main symbol area, CM01—CM32, FA01—FA12, MA01—MA06; the four alternative symbols for MRI, PET, CT, and CAT Imaging listed at the bottom are excluded.

Unified judgment rule: Include in the Multi-Figure Composition Re-test only if there are at least two separately distinguishable human figures, each with its own head and torso or body; reclining figures and figures within pictures (picture-in-picture) count; isolated heads, hands, or organs, equipment images, and the teddy bear in the Pediatrics symbol do not count as figures.

Result of this step: Determine the current predicate; each formal member retains only one row; do not retrieve or report only positive examples.

## Step 02 · search / Locate the set entry for the specified institution

Action: Example query: "site:segd.org Universal Symbols for Healthcare 2024 PDF". From the search candidates, verify the publishing institution, title, and version, then open the specified set or publication entry.

Evidence observation (archived evidence summary): Traceable sources are the official single-page PDF, the main symbol code/name ordered list, 50 corresponding icons, and the current visual review. The entry provides all candidates and image associations, not a partial sample constructed based on the final hit list.
